title: The Recycle Bin is not a backup
myth: The Recycle Bin is a backup that can undo any data mistake.

beats.say: Dex overwrote every phone number in the org. Relax, the Recycle Bin has my back!
beats.speaker: dex

beats.say: Ada peeks in. The bin holds deleted records, and only briefly.
A bad update deletes nothing. Nothing to get back.
Your records are your job. A real backup restores what was lost.

facts.claim: The Recycle Bin holds deleted records only briefly and does nothing about bad updates.
facts.evidence: the Recycle Bin holds deleted records only briefly and does nothing about bad updates

facts.claim: Under shared responsibility, the customer is responsible for its own records, files, metadata and customizations.
facts.evidence: the customer is responsible for its own records, files, metadata and customizations

facts.claim: Backup & Recover restores data that was lost or corrupted.
facts.evidence: and restores what was lost or corrupted
